text: What does the number 0.1 actually hold when stored as a double?
choices: An unpredictable value that varies between runs
0.1 with some digits truncated at the end
explanation: A binary fraction with 52 fraction bits is a precise rational number, and that is it written out. It is not an approximation of what is stored — it is what is stored. And it is entirely deterministic: the same literal gives the same bits every time, on every conforming machine.
